svg.title: cross-port-kill: pk 3000
svg.desc: A terminal frees ports. pk 3000 frees port 3000 by killing node via SIGTERM (graceful). pk 3000 5173 8000 says port 3000 is already free and frees 5173 and 8000, then "Freed 2 of 2 ports". pk 4000-4003 says ports 4001 and 4003 are already free and frees 4000 and 4002.
